title: 'Hocus Pocus' Tops Disney+ as Halloween Nears
summary:
With Halloween just around the corner, a 33-year-old movie is once again one of the most popular things to watch. 'Hocus Pocus,' a 1993 Disney film, is the No. 1 movie on Disney+, according to FlixPatrol, a website that tracks streaming charts.

The 96-minute movie stars Sarah Jessica Parker, Bette Midler and Kathy Najimy as the Sanderson Sisters, a trio of wicked witches from the 1600s. In the story, a teenage boy named Max and his little sister Dani move to the town of Salem, Massachusetts. Max, who is having trouble fitting in, accidentally brings the witches back. Max, Dani, their new friend Allison and a talking cat named Thackery Binx must work together to stop them. The film was directed by Kenny Ortega.

The movie was not a hit at first. It came out in theaters in July, an odd time for a Halloween film, and it disappointed at the box office. But over the years it became a favorite, especially for people who were kids in the 1990s. It played again and again on cable TV, and many families now watch it every October.

In 2023, for its 30th anniversary, 'Hocus Pocus' even returned to the top 10 at movie theaters. Last year, both the original and its sequel, 'Hocus Pocus 2,' which came out on Disney+, were in the streaming top 10 in the days before Halloween.

Fans have more to look forward to. Disney is working on a third movie, which would turn the story into a trilogy. The writer of the original article hopes 'Hocus Pocus 3' will play in theaters instead of going straight to streaming.
why_it_matters: The movie shows how a film that disappointed at first can become a beloved family tradition, and its popularity is pushing Disney to make another sequel.
